integrity: Exact symbolic coefficients and finite trajectories independently checked; all-horizon claim rests on the analytic drift and weighted harmonic-sum proof. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Local nonzero initial amplitudes at fixed-per-experiment \(a_N=8+\theta/N\), with \(\theta\) fixed. Not a global attractor theorem, and no uniformity for unbounded detuning. Prior critical logarithmic coefficient at \(\theta=0\) explicitly credited.
title: An exponentially weighted logarithmic crossover at the neutral flip of a sigmoid interval map
